name: Atom
description: Domain appraisal with reasoning and comparable sales, domain discovery, name generation, availability, details and trademark screening through Atom's official hosted MCP server. Sign up with a normal Atom account and authorize domains:read. Tool schemas are discovered from Atom. A one-time public OAuth client registration is needed for this catalog's OAuth setup; no enterprise contract or API key is required. Documentation: https://www.atom.com/atom-mcp-server/docs.

setup_steps: Create or use a normal Atom account at https://www.atom.com/.

Register a public OAuth client once at POST https://www.atom.com/oauth/register with JSON: {"client_name":"Apteva","redirect_uris":["<the exact callback URL shown here>"],"grant_types":["authorization_code","refresh_token"],"response_types":["code"],"token_endpoint_auth_method":"none"}. Metadata is published at https://www.atom.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server.

Enter the returned client_id in this connection's OAuth setup. No client_secret is required. Our catalog OAuth flow uses a registered client; it does not perform Dynamic Client Registration automatically.

Connect, log in and approve domains:read. The upstream appraise_domain tool is discovered after authorization. This connector requests read access; domain purchasing requires a separately approved domains:register scope.
Appraisal costs and per-token limits are governed by Atom. Handle 429 responses and Retry-After; no free/unlimited API quota is promised.
